name: VibeSense
tagline: Translates the facial expressions of people you talk to into haptic cues for blind users.
problem: Blind people miss facial expressions and must rely on tone and context.
solution: Computer vision and biometric sensing detect expressions in real time and convert them to vibration patterns.
demo_moment: Team-described: someone smiles and the wearer feels it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Presage” among 169 submissions.
Turns a sensing SDK into a social aid.

lessons: Haptics are a natural output channel for accessibility demos.
